info.title: Smart-eCommerce Platform API
info.description: Platform contracts. Catalog, interaction capture, recommendations, assistant, image/voice search, cart, checkout, customer/operator demo identity and sessions with self-service password rotation, account/order history, owned order/shipment reads, customer-initiated cancellation, operator order reads and lifecycle actions, BO-04 trained fraud assessment and review, BO-01 inventory forecasting/reordering, BO-02 dynamic pricing, BO-03 RFM segmentation, and BI-01 analytics are implemented.

rules.title: Rules
default: Price moves with demand relative to observed supply.
A higher competitor cost pulls the price up; a lower one pulls it down.
The configured season multiplier is applied last.
One price change is applied per observation; reruns do not compound it.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.default: Independent quintiles per dimension. Recency is scored so fewer days score higher; frequency and monetary score higher values higher. Ties share a score computed from the empirical distribution. A cohort smaller than the minimum scores neutrally at 3.

definitions.title: Definitions
default: Product views: browsing events with event_type = view in the selected range.
Sessions: distinct session identifiers with at least one event in the range.
Add to cart: browsing events with event_type = add_to_cart.
Orders per session: created orders divided by sessions with any event. Anonymous and non-converting sessions stay in the denominator.
Order count: orders in confirmed, shipped, delivered, or refunded state.
Gross sales: sum of order subtotals before refunds.
Refunds: sum of recorded refund totals.
Net sales: gross sales minus refunds.
Average order value: net sales divided by order count.
Profit is not displayed: the project holds no complete cost coverage.
